work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of a committed live gpt-4o-mini text-to-SQL strategy comparison. The benchmark-defined arms are baseline without schema, schema-aware, and schema plus a single retry only after an execution error. W1 preserves deterministic execution accuracy and source outcome counts while treating the strategies as benchmark-scaffolded conditions rather than canonical harness identities.

source_known_dimensions: same gpt-4o-mini model label and OpenAI chat.completions client
same temperature 0 and JSON response format
same deterministic 20-question benchmark and generated DuckDB data
same gold-result execution comparator and category classifier
same question wording and base SQL-generation contract
one source-reported live run over each strategy arm
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: baseline omits schema while the other two arms include it by design
agentic arm may make an extra model call only when the first SQL fails to execute
request-level raw model responses and token telemetry are not committed
run order and transient service-state effects are not pinned
trajectory variance beyond one published run

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admitted as a committed live-run result with inspectable benchmark and strategy implementation; absence of request-level traces remains explicit

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The source explicitly says it is not a controlled single-agent-versus-swarm test and identifies same-model formation comparison as future work. W1 does not turn the single-agent feasibility result into cross-harness evidence.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: publisher claims about which SQL strategy is the big win or whether retry helps correctness
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 preserves strategy definitions and factual outcome counts only. Mechanism or causal interpretation is downstream.

results.scope: temporary write-enabled registry regeneration plus repository validation and record-specific admission check
